messages.en: What hairstyle should I do?
Should I show my forehead again?

messages.ko: 나는 하연이가 반묶음 했을때 그렇게 공주같드라
messages.en: I think you look just like a princess when you wear your hair in a half-up style.
Then how about half-up with half my bangs up?
Half and half.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Right, let's go with the half-and-half chicken concept.

messages.ko: 메이크업도 얼굴 왼쪽은 청순 오른쪽은 시크컨셉으로하자
messages.en: Let's make the makeup half innocent on the left side and half chic on the right side too.
Oh, hearing that just reminded me of something.
I had a dream.
Even in my dream, I was thinking about what hairstyle I should do.
Then...
My hairstylist said,
"How about an unbalanced hairstyle today?"
And then...

messages.ko: 한쪽은 빠글빠글하고 한쪽은 아예 쭉 피신거야
messages.en: One side of my hair was super curly, while the other side was completely straight.
So I said,

messages.ko: 음…! 조아요! 이제 메이크업 받으러 갈게요!
messages.en: "Hmm...! I like it! I'll go get my makeup done now!"
Then I went to the makeup room.
The makeup artist also said,
"Since your hair is unbalanced, let's make the makeup unbalanced too."

messages.ko: 하고 한쪽은 완전 쎄고 무섭고 다크한데
messages.en: So one side became super fierce, scary, and dark,
while the other side was completely hot pink.
I stared at myself in the mirror, feeling completely conflicted.
Then I ended up going to the broadcast.
I had to walk the red carpet.
While I was taking pictures...
A reporter asked,
"Hayeon, what's wrong with your face?"
And because of that...
I burst into tears right there.

messages.ko: 근데 그러고 레드카펫에 이상하게 하고와놓고 펑펑 운 아이돌로 유명해져서
messages.en: Then I became famous as the idol who showed up looking weird on the red carpet and cried her eyes out.
After that, I think I just kept going around like that.
When I woke up, it left such a strong impression on me.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Y/n, do you have a dream that left a strong impression on you?

messages.ko: 난 초등학교때 꿨던 우리동네에 좀비나온꿈은 아직도 기억나 내용 모두다
messages.en: I still remember a dream I had in elementary school where zombies appeared in my neighborhood. I remember every detail.
If I ever appear in your dream...
it'll definitely be a dream you'll never forget.

messages.ko: 꿈보다 더 꿈같은 현실을 보내자 우리❤️데헷
messages.en: Let's live a reality that's even more dreamlike than a dream. ❤️ Dehet.
